counterexamples.title: E=8000, D=7550, U=322, P=128, window steady
counterexamples.note: Table legacy column is written as U/E=4.025%, which is the A3 quantity legacyMetricSuspensionFraction = U/(D+U+P) = U/E. The A2 quantity legacyEndpointFraction = U/(D+U) = 322/7872 -> 4.0904%. The verdicts (legacy PASS / new FAIL) are unchanged; only the printed percentage of the A2 quantity was mistyped. See defect list D-7 and docs/endpoint-errata-P011-terminal-nondeposited-v1.md.
